question: How is Diginex positioned against larger ESG software competitors like Workiva or Enablon?

beats.line: Start with the size gap. Workiva is a seven billion dollar plus public company.
beats.headline: $7B+ MARKET CAP
beats.action: A tall halftone paper bar rises from the bottom edge, fills the frame and holds over a cream chip.
beats.delivery: [presenting to camera] Start with the size gap. Workiva is a seven billion dollar plus public company.
beats.narration: Start with the size gap. Workiva is a seven billion dollar plus public company. Diginex? Thirty-four million market cap — a micro-cap challenger. It can't match their sales force, brand recognition, or installed base.

beats.line: Diginex? Thirty-four million market cap — a micro-cap challenger.
beats.headline: $34M MARKET CAP
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the top edge as the tall paper bar shifts left; a small paper bar lands beside it, and a black ribbon stretches between them with a coin-sized cream tag reading '$34M' beside it, a short black line pointing at it.
beats.delivery: Diginex? Thirty-four million market cap — a micro-cap challenger.
beats.narration: Start with the size gap. Workiva is a seven billion dollar plus public company. Diginex? Thirty-four million market cap — a micro-cap challenger. It can't match their sales force, brand recognition, or installed base.

beats.line: So Diginex plays a different game. Not out-engineering Workiva on SEC filings.
beats.headline: HORIZONTAL NOT VERTICAL
beats.action: The previous chip is covered as the stacked sheets fuse into one wide paper platform sheet; a torn filing strip slides off its right edge and away.
beats.delivery: [fast-paced] So Diginex plays a different game. Not out-engineering Workiva on SEC filings.
beats.narration: So Diginex plays a different game. Not out-engineering Workiva on SEC filings. It's building one platform spanning carbon accounting, supply chain transparency, and customer data. The bet? Enterprises prefer a single vendor over point solutions from many.

beats.line: But the thesis only works if cross-sell actually happens. If customers buy only carbon accounting, the advantage evaporates.
beats.headline: CROSS-SELL RISK
beats.action: The previous chip slides off the bottom edge as the stamped platform sheet tears down to a single paper module card; a torn paper price strip enters at the right and an orange string runs between them.
beats.delivery: But the thesis only works if cross-sell actually happens. If customers buy only carbon accounting, the advantage evaporates.
beats.narration: But the thesis only works if cross-sell actually happens. If customers buy only carbon accounting, the advantage evaporates. And four acquisitions across multiple geographies is complex. Larger rivals can bundle ESG modules and undercut Diginex on price.

beats.line: Which leaves an eighteen to twenty-four month window to prove platform traction.
beats.headline: 18–24 MONTHS
beats.action: The previous chip flips away as the sagging string straightens into a paper calendar strip; the tall paper bar returns at the right and a cream ribbon runs from the strip to it.
beats.delivery: Which leaves an eighteen to twenty-four month window to prove platform traction.
beats.narration: Which leaves an eighteen to twenty-four month window to prove platform traction. Deliver by late twenty twenty-six, and it's an acquisition target. Stall, and it's a niche player squeezed between incumbents.
